additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466441-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002201] Short charging sessions CRM:02699000270
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I am reaching out in regards of SLA ticket
ID0466441.
I had a quick check to some of the timestamps provided. For the failed session on 06.12.2025, I see the same behavior as described in the other ticket
0466442
.
During the charging session, an error on the LEM triggers an OCPPStopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on. This bug has already been addressed by R&D, and a fix is already included in the recently released
FW v8.1.4.
Please proceed to update the charger at v8.1.4 as soon as possible.
I will come back to you with a complete analysis of all the timestamps provided shortly.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466441-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002201] Short charging sessions CRM:02699000270
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I am following up on ticket
ID0466441.
Here is a complete analysis of the sessions reported by you:
Short session on 06.12.2025
:
I see the same behavior as described in the other ticket
0466442
.
During the charging session, an error on the LEM triggers an OCPPStopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on. This bug has already been addressed by R&D, and a fix is already included in the recently released
FW v8.1.4.
Short session on 07.12.2025 15:36:
Same reason as above. The charger actually goes on:
Short session 07.12.2025 17:06:
​​​​​​​
Session stopped by the charger, as the EV requested a sudden Target current =0 A without then changing accordingly the control pilot state.
Short sessions 08.12.2025:
​​​​​​​
The first session at 11:53 failed on DC1 at 11:57 with the following error detected by EcoG: "code":67,"msg":"ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B". Hence it is a EV related issue. EVMAC: 48.31.33.03.8e.56.
The second session reported failed on DC4 at 11:59 due to an unexpected error identified by the EcoG, as if the vehicle stopped the SLAC communication. I could not find an explanation for this event.
The third session reported again is not a short session, but it was reported as one due to the
error on the LEM which triggers an OCPPStopTransaction.
In conclusion, most of the sessions failed due to this error on the LEM, which is solved in
FW v8.1.4.
, while the other sessions highlighted failed due to EV errors or wrong behavior.
It is necessary then to update the charger to
v8.1.4
as soon as possible. The charger is currently running on v8.0.5, and v8.1.4 is already rolled out.
Should I proceed to update the charger to v8.1.4 during office hours, or will you take care to launch the update on SCB?
Please let me know if you need support to update the charger. I will then proceed to close the ticket, as the analysis has been provided and the bug and bugfix communicated.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

Technical Support Engineer

13629 Berlin, Germany
